dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Ouch, ouch, ouch, I got sawdust in my eyes! Coach Iansan, help...!

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: Open your eyes. Let me see if I can get it out for you.

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: *sobbing*... I can't open them, and I can't stop the tears...

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: That's why I told you to wear protective goggles...

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: Just lie down, I'll go get some water to wash it out.
